plan.previousGoalTurnClassification: progress: verified and pushed bounded retry evidence; exact baseline restored
plan.mechanism: One suite-owned native browser with original client/context leases and context-scoped renderer reuse, bounded locator initializer source-reference cache, 1ms uncapped frame grid, first retirement recheck at250us. No new timing parameters or weakened checks. All components applied together under one policy.
plan.rationale: Prior direct sharing improved four-worker applications10–19%, source references reduced single-worker TodoMVC7–11%, pacing plus early retirement reduced setup and four-worker TodoMVC but not all application cells. Those ratios cannot be multiplied. This distinct composition tests removal of duplicated browser work, repeated source transport and scheduling overhead together.
functionalBeforeTiming: native direct WebSocket tests and existing connection suite
source-reference realm replacement and mismatch controls
real-time moving target, trusted input and screenshot/media controls

timing.order: three arms forward then reverse; fixed feature policy for every test/application/worker
timing.completeBoundary: watchdog-owned fixture/browser/runner startup through natural drain, including shared browser startup/shutdown

advanceGate.description: Both applications at both worker counts must reach stock Playwright / candidate >=2 in both reversed blocks; candidate must not regress elapsed or outer-owner charged CPU >5% versus same-binary separate baseline in any cell. This is only an engineering gate to the unchanged nine-scenario campaign, not final admission.

scope.policy: Stock Playwright reference; identical candidate binaries in separate-browser baseline and combined shared-browser treatment. Fresh original tests/contexts, native input, real clocks and ordinary storage retained. Four-core quota,CPUs0–5,8GiB,swap0,Nice10.
scope.elapsedBoundary: Watchdog-owned fixture/server, browser and runner startup through natural observed drain; unused renderer reservations and shared-browser shutdown included.
scope.cpuBoundary: Outer owner cgroup delta starts before shared browser and inner fixture/runner creation, ends after shared browser shutdown. Excludes outer module imports, final report write and watchdog drain. Not complete resource admission.
scope.preflightTiming: Retained separately; not included in the eight comparison pairs.

decision.interpretation: Same fixed combination across both applications/worker counts. Two reversed blocks only, no final confidence. Outer-owner CPU includes browser startup/shutdown but excludes its initial imports and watchdog/report drain.

verification.limit: Reported original context/host/process joins, not independent complete native lifetime/resource custody.

limitations: Source inspection is not runtime proof.
Shared client cleanup relies on dispose-on-detach, original handler destruction and held-adoption rollback.
Borrow endpoint validates product string; actual executable/flags are supplied by suite-owned launch receipts.
Enabled pacing GPU/multi-observer/native ACK boundaries and broader worker races remain open.

retainedFailures.detail: Initial controller looked for media-controls.json although unchanged media fixture emits frame-controls.json. Original media-off execution succeeded. Existing report verified and six remaining enabled captures executed; no completed capture rerun.

Initial verifier expected cache hits in client-death control, whose locator actions occur only after context cycling. That control recorded misses/stores. Repeated-frame control records two hits; verifier corrected to inspect it. No browser work rerun.

limitations: Two reversed blocks do not establish confidence intervals or the final nine-scenario majority.

Both TodoMVC worker counts and four-worker SVGOMG exceed2 in both orders. Single-worker SVGOMG is1.816/2.310; the prospective all-application engineering gate fails. Do not promote or repeat an unchanged larger campaign.
The compound changes cannot be causally apportioned or reconstructed by multiplying earlier ratios.
All comparison cells improve versus the same-binary separate baseline, but candidate defaults remain unadopted.
Original test identities, request contracts, worker guards and reported context/host/process joins are verified. They are not complete independent native callback/lifetime/resource custody.
Public API/configuration parity, full-current-core refresh, broader hardware/native fault coverage, other platforms, release and final confidence/resource admission remain open.
